thread:
Priya: quick flag1
the 7d 'cache savings' card shows negative values for some tenants after the deploy. Example: tenant_8245 shows -$12.40.
Dan: likely mixing live stream with reconciled MV. we query prefetch_stream for realtime.
Olivia: product expects 'savings' >= 0 in the summary. prefer we hide noise for tiny tenants.
Rex: backend fix: add reconciled_at + reconcile_batch_id to MV so UI can detect freshness.
Dan: UX approach: clamp main summary to >=0 for tenants with samples < 50 and show an "insufficient data" state, with a chevron to expand raw value.
Priya: add telemetry when values are clamped: econ.card.clamped with tenant_id + reason.
Olivia: tooltip copy: "Amortized cache credits reconcile periodically; small tenants may show temporary negative raw values. Expand to see raw metrics."
Rex: expose API param freshness=live|reconciled so exports can opt for reconciled numbers.
Dan: CI smoke check: fail if any tenant shows savings < -0.02 * monthly_cost without reconciled_at older than 1h.
Priya: timeline: MV migration + flag today, UI clamp + tooltip by EOW.
deploy-bot: job queued: reconciler-mv-migration -> staging (by @Rex).
Rex: PR up for MV change; will wire reconciled_at and open follow-ups for API + UI.
Priya: validated on staging: clamped summary and chevron shows raw negative. thanks team!
